id: \rI need a break. Remember to save often. Wait what?
en: \rI need a break. Remember to save often. Wait what?
it: \rHo bisogno di una pausa. Ricorda di salvare spesso. Aspetta, cosa?

id: \rNanijin ga kore o rikai shite imasu ka?
en: \rNanijin ga kore o rikai shite imasu ka?
it: \rNanijin ga kore o rikai shite imasu ka?

id: \rAnata ga rikai sureba, Aether Paradise no Master Ball ni tsuite wasurenaide kudasai.
en: \rAnata ga rikai sureba, Aether Paradise no Master Ball ni tsuite wasurenaide kudasai.
it: \rAnata ga rikai sureba, Aether Paradise no Master Ball ni tsuite wasurenaide kudasai.

id: \bGladion: \PN? I didn't expect to see anyone else here.
en: \bGladion: \PN? I didn't expect to see anyone else here.
it: \bIridio: \PN? Non mi aspettavo di vedere qualcun altro qui.

id: \bI'm just training one of my Pokémon. Want to help?
en: \bI'm just training one of my Pokémon. Want to help?
it: \bSto solo allenando uno dei miei Pokémon. Vuoi darmi una mano?

id: \bGladion: Impressive. I think Silvally will get better soon.
en: \bGladion: Impressive. I think Silvally will get better soon.
it: \bIridio: Notevole. Credo che Silvally migliorerà presto.

id: \bSo you got lost. I'll help you find your way back.
en: \bSo you got lost. I'll help you find your way back.
it: \bQuindi ti sei perso. Ti aiuterò a ritrovare la strada.

id: Rotom Dex: I think Charizard can take us back if we ever want to go there.
en: Rotom Dex: I think Charizard can take us back if we ever want to go there.
it: Rotom Dex: Credo che Charizard possa riportarci qui se mai volessimo tornarci.

id: \bI had my Charizard fly me here.
en: \bI had my Charizard fly me here.
it: \bMi sono fatto portare qui in volo dal mio Charizard.

id: \bI'm sure one could fly you here too.
en: \bI'm sure one could fly you here too.
it: \bSono sicuro che anche un Charizard potrebbe portarti qui in volo.
